interface Box<T> { value: T }
class Wrapped<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} }
type Id<X> = X;
type Generic<T> = T extends infer U ? Box<Id<U>> : never;
type ArrayElement<T> = T extends (infer U)[] ? Box<Id<U>> : never;
type TupleElement<T> = T extends [infer U] ? Box<Id<U>> : never;
type WrappedTuple<T> = T extends infer U ? Box<[Id<U>]> : never;
type Constructed<T> = T extends infer U ? Wrapped<Id<U>> : never;
type Constrained<T> = T extends infer U extends string ? Box<Id<U>> : never;
type Fixed<T> = string extends infer U ? Box<Id<U>> : never;
type Pattern<T> = T extends Box<Id<infer U>> ? U : never;
const text: Generic<string> = { value: 'one' };
const count: Generic<number> = { value: 2 };
const array: ArrayElement<string[]> = { value: 'three' };
const tuple: TupleElement<[string]> = { value: 'four' };
const wrapped: WrappedTuple<string> = { value: ['five'] };
const instance: Constructed<string> = new Wrapped('six');
const constrained: Constrained<string> = { value: 'seven' };
const fixed: Fixed<number> = { value: 'eight' };
const pattern: Pattern<{ value: string }> = 'nine';
console.log(text.value.toUpperCase(), count.value.toFixed(), array.value.toUpperCase(), tuple.value.toUpperCase());
console.log(wrapped.value[0].toUpperCase(), instance.value.toUpperCase(), constrained.value.toUpperCase(), fixed.value.toUpperCase(), pattern.toUpperCase());

class Base {
  wrap(value: this) {
    type Result = Box<this>;
    const result: Result = { value };
    return result;
  }
}
class Derived extends Base { extra = 42 }
console.log(new Derived().wrap(new Derived()).value.extra);
